thread:
Maya: Follow-up from the RFC: ingest pipelines hit a burst of failures when project-scoped keys rotated. We need a safe fallback + a runbook. Quick ideas?
Raj: Saw ~700 write errors over ~4m last week. Consumers kept using expired tokens in sidecars.
Priya: Root cause: short TTL + cached tokens + no coordinated refresh.
Tom: Proposal: add a controlled token-exchange endpoint that can issue a narrowly-scoped org:read token when project tokens fail. Must be gated.
Maya: Gate how?
Tom: require mTLS svc-identity + per-service flag allow_org_exchange=true + IAM check. Also return an audit_id for every exchange.
Raj: Ops: how to prevent thundering exchanges if many writers fail?
Priya: Client-side: exponential backoff + jitter. Server-side: per-service rate-limit and Retry-After header. Upstream should cache exchange token.
Maya: Runbook sketch: 1) Alert when auth.expired.rate spikes or auth.exchange.errors>threshold. 2) Identify service via auth.context.service. 3) If allow_org_exchange true -> automated exchange attempt (idempotent). 4) If exchange OK: notify owners, monitor. 5) If disabled or exchange fails: pause writes, page SRE+PO, apply rollback or throttling. 6) Postmortem + TTL tuning.
Tom: API example: POST /auth/v1/exchange with Authorization: Bearer <token> and body {"target_scope":"org:read"}. Response includes token, expires_in=600, audit_id.
Priya: Client retry guidance: base 200ms, factor 2, max 5 attempts, jitter 0-200ms. Upstream must avoid per-fanout duplicate exchanges.
Raj: Who approves allow_org_exchange flips? Platform + Security sign-off. Default off; service owners request via infra portal with justification/test plan.
Maya: Telemetry: add labels service, project, route, exchange_attempted, exchange_result and emit auth.exchange.{success|failure|rate_limited} audit events.
ops-bot: FYI deploy: auth-exchange v0.1 rolled to canary at 1755002500 :rocket:
Maya: Next steps: Tom to draft API PR, Priya to update SDK retry docs, Raj to add runbook to incidents playbook, Security to own approval flow.
Raj: I'll add the dashboard queries for auth.exchange.rate and auth.expired.rate.
Tom: Will include server rate limiting + audit in PR.
Priya: I'll add sample code snippet and upstream caching guidance.
Maya: Thanks team, tagging @oncall once runbook is live.
